dual_basis_summary.size_tier_verdict: MEGA (deployable core) insignificant/weakly-negative for ALL surfaces; MID insignificant. Signal localizes entirely in SMALL tier (outside deploy relevance).

adversarial_challenge_resolution.C1_survivorship: PIT universe used (time-varying K200/KQ150 membership). Audit data = current constituents => delisted-after-distress firms absent => historical distress signal UNDERESTIMATED (conservative). But irrelevant to deployable exclusion: MEGA/MID tiers insignificant regardless of survivorship; forward-investable large caps show no flag->underperformance.
adversarial_challenge_resolution.C2_sparsity_vs_power: S1 = genuine sparsity (2 firms). S2-S4 have ample counts (152/14/29 flagged/mo) => NOT a power wall; cap-w null is real. Tier decomposition resolves the large EW spread as SMALL-tier size artifact, not hidden power.
adversarial_challenge_resolution.C3_kam_era_bias: S4 scoped to 2020+ (FY2019 KAM 실효). cap-w -0.36 + MEGA -0.69 both insignificant; verdict explicitly period-scoped, not generalized to pre-2019.
